Biography

Dr Mark B. Hill, BEng PhD CEng MIET

Mark is Lead CPU Architect at Codasip and has 30 years industrial experience in processor and processor subsystem design and development at plus a BEng(Hons) First and a PhD from Southampton University. He has been involved in the design and development of several RISC-V cores for over the last 7 years for use in a wide range of industrial and consumer products and been a strong advocate of CHERI for several years.
